instruction: I'm concerned about accidentally setting VLC's volume too high and damaging my speakers. How can I configure VLC to limit the maximum volume to 200% instead of the default higher limit?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);
